title: New Testament Manuscript Evidence
keywords: how many manuscripts of the new testament
content: The New Testament is supported by over 5,000 Greek manuscripts and thousands more in Latin and other ancient languages. Some manuscript fragments date to within decades of the original writings. This large amount of evidence allows scholars to compare copies and reconstruct the original text with high accuracy. Compared to other ancient works, the New Testament has far greater manuscript support.

title: Dead Sea Scrolls and Old Testament Preservation
keywords: how old are the dead sea scrolls
content: The Dead Sea Scrolls were discovered in 1947 near the Dead Sea and contain some of the oldest known manuscripts of the Old Testament. Many of these scrolls date from around 200 BC to AD 70. When scholars compared them with later manuscripts such as the Masoretic Text, they found remarkable consistency, confirming that the Old Testament was preserved with great accuracy through centuries of copying.
